sentences.en: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
sentences.zh: 一辆卡车停在了路中间。

sentences.en: The man standing by the door is a famous singer.
sentences.zh: 站在门口的那个男人是一位著名的歌手。

sentences.en: Who is the man standing in front of the building?
sentences.zh: 站在大楼前面的男人是谁？

senses.zh: 站立；坚持不变；坐落于（stand的ing形式）
